hosts.blocking_gap: CORRECTED 2026-09-11, same day: there is NO blocking gap. isaaclab_tasks and isaaclab_rl ARE present, inside the PyPI isaaclab wheel at site-packages/isaaclab/source/{isaaclab,isaaclab_assets,isaaclab_contrib,isaaclab_mimic,isaaclab_rl,isaaclab_tasks}. find_spec returned None only because those directories are not on sys.path by default. Adding them to PYTHONPATH resolves isaaclab, isaaclab.app, isaaclab_tasks, isaaclab_rl and isaaclab_assets. isaaclab_tasks.utils.parse_cfg still needs `pxr`, which exists only after AppLauncher starts Isaac Sim - the adapter launches the app before importing it, so that is the normal order, not a gap.
hosts.why_the_gap_exists: E01 was locomotion TRAINING through robot_lab's own scripts and rsl_rl; it never needed Isaac Lab's task registry or the RSL-RL vec-env wrapper.
hosts.cost_to_close: one PYTHONPATH entry per package directory; no download, no image rebuild, no version mixing.
hosts.cameras: RTX rendering is available on the host (the vendor container is livestreaming right now) but enable_cameras inside these images is unproven. This is the Phase B go/no-go.
hosts.superseded_claim: The first version of this survey said the 4090 could not run the adapter. That was wrong: it read a find_spec None as 'absent' when the correct reading is 'not on sys.path'. The cost of staying on the 4090 is a PYTHONPATH entry, not an Isaac Lab source install.
